response: Portable ultrasonography is an adequate methodology for evaluating Schanz pin placement during extremity fracture fixation in austere environments. Although there may be some statistical imparity in pin protrusion measurement via ultrasound compared to gross dissection, the clinical relevance of ultrasound measurement bias is considered acceptable in such settings. Therefore, ultrasonography can be used as a reliable method for assessing Schanz pin placement in austere operating environments.
